purpose: Quality management: burden of acute infections on inpatient wards.
question: In 2024, how many admissions with pneumonia or a urinary tract infection as main diagnosis did each Spital have, how many different patients were that and how long did a stay last on average?
definitions: An admission is an inpatient encounter; its main diagnosis is the primary diagnosis of the stay.
Pneumonia and urinary tract infection both count; the main diagnosis of a stay is one or the other.
Count admissions that started in 2024, per hospital (data holder of the stay).
Average stay length in days = end date minus start date, one decimal.
Per hospital: admissions, distinct patients admitted and the mean length of stay.
